form.privacyConsentBody:
Soul Trace (Eternal Beam) uses your information as follows.

· What we collect: your email, your pet’s details (name, nickname, species, years together, etc.), your survey answers, and the AI-generated letter
· Why: to create and deliver your memory letter, provide Eternal Beam services, and improve the experience
· How long we keep it: we delete it once we no longer need it for those purposes (or as long as the law requires)
· Your choice: you can decline, but you may not be able to use the service without consent.
form.privacyConsentAgree: I have read the above and agree to how my information is collected and used.
form.photoPrivacyConsentBody:
Photos you upload may count as personal information under privacy law.

· What we collect: the pet photo you upload (including anything visible in the image)
· Why: video creation and Eternal Beam–related services
· How long we keep it: we delete it once we no longer need it (or as long as the law requires)
· Please only upload photos you took or have permission to share. Avoid photos that clearly show other people’s faces or private details.
· Your choice: you can decline, but photo upload and video features will not be available.
form.photoPrivacyConsentAgree: I have read the above and agree to how my photo is used.

memory.promptText: How did ○○ show you they loved you?
